title: Fix production password recovery redirect

issue.title: TASK-e7b4 Fix production password recovery redirect

description: Исправить восстановление пароля Ezda: production reset email должен возвращать пользователя в production auth flow вместо localhost, а recovery callback должен безопасно устанавливать новую сессию и пароль.
requirements: Формировать recovery redirect URL с production/local поведением, не зависящим от ошибочного Supabase Site URL.
Добавить server-side recovery callback и страницу установки нового пароля.
Сохранять access/refresh tokens только в HttpOnly cookies.
Добавить regression tests для redirect selection и recovery callback/update-password error handling.
Добавить контролируемую E2E-проверку recovery flow и документацию по Supabase Reset Password template/Redirect URLs.
definitionOfReady: GitHub Issue #84 создан с acceptance criteria и technical approach.
Текущий /api/auth/recover и server-side Supabase Auth adapter изучены.
acceptanceCriteria: Production reset email uses https://ezda-eta.vercel.app/auth/recover rather than localhost.
Valid recovery callback consumes token_hash server-side, establishes HttpOnly session cookies, and redirects to a clean password-update page.
New password is saved through a server-side authenticated endpoint.
Invalid/expired recovery links show a clear error without echoing the token.
npm run tasks:validate, npm run test:run, and npm run build pass.
technicalApproach: Use an explicit auth redirect helper with NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL/VERCEL_URL and safe localhost fallback.
Keep the existing server-side REST adapter and cookie helpers; add recovery token verification and update-user operations.
Use a /auth/recover callback with token_hash/type=recovery and a /auth/reset-password client page that talks only to the Ezda API.
Document the Supabase Reset Password email template using .RedirectTo and .TokenHash.
definitionOfDone: Task metadata contains history and commit metadata.
Implementation is delivered through a protected PR targeting main.

history.details: Task created from GitHub Issue #84; metadata is included in the implementation PR.

Added production/local/preview auth redirect selection, server recovery callback, HttpOnly password update flow, regression tests, recovery E2E provider support, and Supabase configuration documentation.

decisionLog.decision: Use NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL for production and VERCEL_URL for previews, while preserving request origin on localhost.
decisionLog.reason: The observed recovery link incorrectly used localhost in production; explicit deployment-aware origin selection prevents Supabase Site URL drift from controlling application redirects.
